name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension (Straight Bar)
description: An overhead cable extension using a straight bar attached to a low pulley. The straight bar allows a pronated grip position that some lifters find creates better mind-muscle connection with the triceps. This is a classic bodybuilding exercise for the long head.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Overhead Cable Triceps Extension (Straight Bar) in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Overhead Cable Triceps Extension (Straight Bar).
steps: Step 1: Attach straight bar to low pulley. Face away from cable holding bar overhead.
Step 2: Keep upper arms vertical with elbows by ears.
Step 3: Extend elbows to press bar overhead to full lockout.
Step 4: Lower bar slowly behind head to full stretch position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Full extension and stretch each rep
